content.value_statement: Many portfolios show work without guiding visitors toward a clear decision. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan portfolio structure, case studies, interaction patterns, and conversion points.
actual_capabilities: Plan a portfolio structure that passes a quick visitor scan.
Define hero, project, about, contact, and testimonial sections.
Shape project cards and case studies around role, process, and results.
Suggest interactive portfolio ideas with usability and mobile tradeoffs.
Review portfolios for contact clarity, mobile readiness, image performance, and missing impact.
limitations: Does not build a complete website by itself.
Does not replace user research, hiring feedback, or expert design review.
Requires real project details, images, results, and contact preferences.
Interactive concepts still need implementation and device testing.

use_cases.title: Plan a Developer Portfolio
use_cases.description: Create a clear site structure, select strong projects, and highlight technical depth for hiring managers.

use_cases.title: Improve a Design Portfolio
use_cases.description: Turn visual work into readable case studies with process, decisions, outcomes, and a strong contact path.

use_cases.title: Shape a Creative Portfolio
use_cases.description: Balance memorable interaction ideas with accessibility, mobile performance, and easy navigation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Portfolio Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the interactive-portfolio skill to outline my portfolio. I am a [role], my target audience is [audience], and my strongest projects are [projects].

prompt_templates.title: Select Portfolio Projects
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate user choosing what to feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the interactive-portfolio skill to help me choose 3 to 5 portfolio projects from this list: [project list]. Rank them for [job type or client type].

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite a Case Study
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the interactive-portfolio skill to turn this project description into a concise case study with challenge, role, process, decisions, and results: [project notes].

prompt_templates.title: Audit Portfolio Conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the interactive-portfolio skill to audit my portfolio for the 30-second test, mobile readiness, project impact, and contact conversion. Here is the current content: [portfolio content].

output_examples.input: I need a developer portfolio for frontend roles with four projects.
output: A homepage structure with a direct hero, featured work, about section, and contact call to action.
A project selection order that leads with the strongest frontend evidence.
Case study prompts that ask for role, technical decisions, performance work, and measurable results.

output_examples.input: My portfolio looks good but nobody contacts me.
output: A conversion review that checks whether availability, contact links, and primary actions are visible.
Recommended call to action placement in the hero, after projects, and footer.
Copy suggestions that replace vague links with specific next steps.

output_examples.input: I want a memorable creative portfolio without hurting usability.
output: A set of interaction ideas ranked by impact and usability risk.
Mobile-first constraints for animation, hover effects, navigation, and load time.
A launch checklist for real-device testing and graceful degradation.

best_practices: Start with the target audience and the decision you want them to make.
Show fewer projects with stronger context, proof, and outcomes.
Test the portfolio on real mobile devices before launch.
anti_patterns: Using complex interactions that hide the actual work.
Listing projects without explaining your role or impact.
Treating the contact section as an afterthought.

faq.question: What kind of portfolio does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports developer, designer, creative, and freelance portfolios that need clearer structure and stronger presentation.

faq.question: Can it help me choose projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It can rank projects by relevance, proof of skill, impact, and fit for a target audience.

faq.question: Does it create visual designs?
faq.answer: It can guide layout, interaction, and content decisions, but final visual design still needs implementation.

faq.question: Can it audit an existing portfolio?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review contact clarity, mobile readiness, project impact, load risks, and visitor flow.

faq.question: Does it write case studies?
faq.answer: It helps structure and improve case studies when you provide project details, role, process, and results.

faq.question: Is this only for job seekers?
faq.answer: No. Freelancers and creative professionals can use it to present work and guide visitors toward inquiries.
